title: Urban Emergence at Mahasthangarh
subtitle: Early fortified urbanization in the Bengal region.
summary: Archaeological evidence from Mahasthangarh indicates one of the earliest major fortified urban centers in the Bengal region, with origins around the 4th-3rd century BCE and long continuity of settlement and administration.
heroTagline: Mahasthangarh anchors the deep urban history of Bengal before medieval state transitions.
whyItMatters: This chapter matters because it grounds Bengal's early history in material archaeology and shows long-term institutional continuity before later dynastic phases.
longTermLegacy: This chapter matters because it grounds Bengal's early history in material archaeology and shows long-term institutional continuity before later dynastic phases.
